rawContent: @pammustard @tuftedpuffin @RonanFarrow @MeTooMVMT @JaneMayerNYer @ResearchGate @Tim_Canova I believe the #MeToo activists and researchers are absolutely heroic. I don't think the whole issue of systemic impunity for abusers is fully acknowledged and managed as a social problem yet, however.

I urge everyone on the west coast to consider attending this symposium. Professor Freyd is a excellent researcher on trauma that is associated w/ institutional betrayal, and she is in agreement that it is time to apply what has been learned w/ #MeToo to the financial deceivers.
